title: The enforcement-input ratchet: expected_surfaces mandatory from WP-2026-0126 forward, coverage counted out loud, unmatchable declarations refused, one may-touch semantic across both containment sites
objective: Close GOV-0108's class for the expected_surfaces instance: an optional enforcement input becomes loudly non-covered at the point of judgment AND mandatory by id-threshold ratchet, while the #272 site-disagreement about discovery_allowance is unified under one stated semantic.
business_value: AET-B's gate leg 3: the runtime substrate's containment leans on this control being populated and unambiguous. Ratified as D2 of the #236 checkpoint.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: (a) ratchet -- every work/WP-2026-NNNN record with NNNN >= 0126 (sentinels 0997-0999/9999 exempt) must declare non-empty expected_surfaces.files: refused at self-dossier assembly and RED in validate_repo, both naming the id; (b) coverage counter emitted by repo: declared/grandfathered counts with the threshold named, over-reach and over-declaration counted under DISTINCT labels (#257 discipline); (c) structurally-unmatchable declarations (own work/<id>/ dir, badf/lockfile.json) refused for >= threshold records; (d) the #272 unification -- assembly's unexpected computation consults discovery_allowance exactly as binding does; binding keeps its allowance filter for pre-unification bindings (stated in doctrine)
tests/test_badf_surface_ratchet.py: red-first per the seven conditions incl. one case PER SITE for the unification and the counter's observed-failing case

docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: doctrine -- the class rule, the threshold, the grandfather statement, and the ONE-SENTENCE may-touch semantic: files = must-touch (C7 ceiling, mirror-required); discovery_allowance = may-touch (never unexpected at assembly, never refused at binding, never mirror-required, never widens C7); reserved-unconsumed status of services/interfaces/data stated
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0112.json; reconcile WP-2026-0125; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: any schema change (stop condition: if the unification needs a new schema key, STOP and return to the reviewer); #265/#240 walker/schema work (their own lane and rungs); #231 (candidate second instance, decided after this pattern is real); enforcement or removal of services/interfaces/data (stated, not changed); rewriting any landed record (grandfathered history is counted, never edited)
acceptance_criteria: a >= threshold record without expected_surfaces.files is refused at assembly AND turns repo RED, each naming the id (observed failing case bound as evidence); grandfathered (< threshold) records are counted in the emitted coverage line, never refused, never edited
the coverage line's counts are asserted against independently computed expectations, and adding a record changes them (the counter has been SEEN wrong, not only right)
a >= threshold declaration containing the record's own work/ dir or the lockfile is refused (the VAL-B near-miss shape)

an allowance-covered changed path draws NO C-2 condition at assembly and NO refusal at binding, while a pre-unification binding carrying such a path in unexpected_paths is still exempted at binding (per-site red-first for the former; pinned regression for the latter)
over-reach and over-declaration remain textually and numerically DISTINCT in conditions and counters -- no emitted number can mean two things (#257)
the may-touch semantic exists as ONE doctrine sentence; all pre-existing tests stay green; repo PASS on branch and composed tree; the record's own declaration is exact under the mirror

and no other encoding of the same defect survives: the sub-key x consumer matrix (measured on #272) is re-verified post-change -- no pair of consumers disagrees about any key (the #270 adversarial clause)

test_obligations.claim: the ratchet refuses undeclared >= threshold records at both reporting sites, counts the grandfathered honestly, refuses unmatchable declarations, and unifies the may-touch semantic without disturbing pre-unification bindings

evidence: failing-first: the ratchet/unification positives red against the current gate
mutation: each control branch neutered -> red

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
